fixes.explanation: That one's a stretch, friend, since the psalm never mentions Egypt here. God says, "So I gave them up to their stubborn hearts to follow their own devices." (Psalm 81:12) The verse before says, "But My people would not listen to Me, and Israel would not obey Me." (Psalm 81:11) So He doesn't send them anywhere. He leaves them to their stubborn hearts, going their own way instead of His ways. (Psalm 81:13)

Reasonable guess, friend, but the psalm doesn't mention a prophet here. God says, "So I gave them up to their stubborn hearts to follow their own devices." (Psalm 81:12) Right before it, He says, "But My people would not listen to Me…" (Psalm 81:11) So He lets them go their own way, with their stubborn hearts leading, instead of following His ways. (Psalm 81:13)
